AgentCompass v0.7.7 makes the router's refusals and waits ones you can act on, and prices free and pooled accounts as ordinary quota.

- **A route you name is refused only by a fact.** A used-up window, a confirmed vendor limit, the launch floor or a missing price refuses it, and the answer says which window, its state and, when known, when it ends (`status: blocked`, `caller_action: tell_user`). An estimate no longer refuses a named route: the router launches it with one warning that says what it estimated.
- **`--fast` never blocks a launch by itself.** On a route that cannot run fast, the work launches in its plain mode with one note. Where only the router's estimate of the fast spend stood in the way, a named `--fast` launches fast with one warning. Claude has no fast mode in AgentCompass any more: the opt-in that spent paid usage credits is removed.
- **A free pool is an ordinary quota pool.** OpenCode's free models now take part in automatic routing with a measured daily allowance, and the vendor's "free usage limit reached" error closes the pool until the reset the vendor states. No hold waits for you to clear it by hand: every hold ends by a time or an observed fact. A hold written by an earlier version ends the same way after the update.
- **An account pool is priced by each member's own window.** A gateway pool of several accounts used to read as one merged window (mean use, latest reset), which hid a member whose quota was about to expire. Each member now counts with its own capacity, use and reset; the pool is used up only when every member is.
- **A wait the router offers is one it can keep.** A window that refills is checked against the size of the work before the router offers to wait for it; a wait longer than `--can-wait-hours` allows is a deferral with its next step, not a question.
- **Native launches** are authorized by a one-use hand-over from `roll`; the gate has no model-name rule left and fails closed when it cannot read the registry.
- **State from earlier versions is upgraded on read**: legacy meter fields and `verified: false` no longer exclude an account.
- **Tray and installer**: a hover text no longer stays on screen after its list is rebuilt; the Start menu entry, both executables and the installer carry the compass icon.

The full list is in the [changelog](https://github.com/akiiwa-games/AgentCompass-Router/blob/v0.7.7/CHANGELOG.md).

Verified: the full test suite, once (one test failed on a socket error of the loaded machine and passed alone); the foreign-machine check F01 to F13; the zero-dispatch check, after three of its expectations were brought up to this version; the published reference data against every released reader of its schema; the Windows Sandbox installer check. An open-ended review of the whole version found one defect that would have kept a free pool from closing at its limit on an automatic route; it and three smaller ones are fixed. Not verified: after those review fixes only the tests of the touched modules ran again, not the full suite. Left for a later version: a named effort level with no row of its own passes the record and is refused, with the same reason and time, one step later; a preview (`--dry-run`) of a named route on a closed free pool does not show the refusal the launch gives.

The Windows tray installer is unsigned; Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch. See [packaging/SIGNING.md](https://github.com/akiiwa-games/AgentCompass-Router/blob/v0.7.7/packaging/SIGNING.md).

Status: alpha. Accounts come from discovery on your machine; choose which ones take part in the tray.
